experiment: cvtm_early_logical_attention (pilot: TM T and s range)
status: EXPLORATORY, not pre-registered; held-out TRAINING documents only (part A trains, part C scores); validation is not scored (--stop-after-grid); the test split is never loaded
purpose: choose the T and s range of the main run's TM grid from the copy log-likelihood on part C of the held-out training documents, at 1000 clauses per class and a 20,000-positive training subsample

inputs.train_prefix: first 5,000,000 tokens of WikiText-103 train at V 8000 cut at a document boundary (m3_tiny_lm.slice_train); held-out documents SeedSequence([20260923, 715, 1]), 5 percent; KN-5 (modified, in-house) on the other documents
inputs.heldout_split: held-out documents split by SeedSequence([20260924, 4242, 1]): 55 percent part A (gate training pairs), 45 percent part C (selection, temperature, mixture weights)

gpu: none (CPU only, one thread, nice 19; s4 holds the CPU slots)
